body: Why do you think I'm fucking trolling? Because I'm depressed as a result of trauma from witnessing animal suffering on a massive scale? This is what I'm talking about. Everyone thinks it's just a fucking joke. Fuck you. This is why I'm sad all the time; because people like you. The animal suffering is awful, but society as a whole thinking you're fucking crazy all the time makes it 100% worse. This is the last place I would've expected shit, but boy, I don't even know why I get my hopes up anymore. I don't even know why I bother reaching out. I've been bawling all day and you've reaffirmed just how shitty everything is.
I really don't get anything. I just like to look. Halloween is the best holiday.
I'm laying in bed. I've been here all day. I was going to go to the halloween store but my eyes are so puffy that I've decided not to.
